title: search-index-cluster-2 data corruption — search API degraded on ap-northeast-1
description: The SearchIndex service is severely degraded on ap-northeast-1. Queries against search-index-cluster-2 are returning empty result sets despite data being present in the index. Engineering investigation reveals index corruption at the shard level. All full-text search features are affected for users in this region.

title: Search API returning empty results — search-index-cluster-2 degraded state
description: Users across ap-northeast-1 are reporting that all search queries return zero results. The search API itself responds with HTTP 200 but the result payload is empty. SRE confirms search-index-cluster-2 entered a degraded state at approximately 16:55 UTC due to a corrupted primary shard. Secondary shards also affected.

title: indexer pod OOM on ap-northeast-1 — search-index-cluster-2 fault
description: Indexer pods on ap-northeast-1 are crashing with out-of-memory errors. The pods attempt to rebuild the corrupted shard on search-index-cluster-2 but run out of memory mid-rebuild. This is the same cluster degradation causing the empty search results. All three incidents share the same root cause.

title: SEO team requesting index boost for Q2 marketing campaign
description: The SEO team is launching the Q2 marketing campaign next week and needs several product pages to receive a temporary index boost to improve search ranking. Please coordinate with the search team to apply the boost rules to the specified URL list (attached). This is time-sensitive for the campaign launch.

title: Search A/B test config request — feature flag for new ranking algorithm
description: The product team wants to set up an A/B test for the new BM25+ ranking algorithm. Please configure the feature flag to route 10% of ap-northeast-1 traffic to the new ranking variant. The test should run for 14 days starting April 15. Contact the search team to ensure proper telemetry collection.
